item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:15 PM 26 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Marinduque(Torrijos), #OrientalMindoro(Pola, Victoria, Naujan, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Gloria, CityOfCalapan), #Romblon(Concepcion, Romblon, SantaMaria, Alcantara, SantaFe, SanJose, Looc, Cajidiocan, SanFernando), #Masbate(Mandaon, Balud, Milagros, Aroroy), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Gubat, Casiguran, Juban, Magallanes, Pilar, Castilla, Donsol), #Albay(Manito, LegazpiCity, SantoDomingo, Bacacay, RapuRapu, Daraga, Jovellar, Camalig, Malilipot), #Catanduanes(Virac, Bato, Baras, Gigmoto, SanMiguel, SanAndres), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan), #NorthernSamar(LopeDeVega, Mondragon, SilvinoLobos, LasNavas, Catarman and SanRoque) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque(Mogpog, Boac, Gasan, Buenavista and SantaCruz) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
